note: Snowball stemmer provides a multilingual stemming service (snowball_stemmer.stemmer, wamania/php-stemmer) plus a Search API processor (plugin id snowball_stemmer, extends Search API's Stemmer) and core-search integration via hook_search_preprocess(). No admin settings page/configure route. The processor's only config is 'exceptions' (word => fixed stem), stored on the index config entity at processor_settings.snowball_stemmer.exceptions. Language codes are normalized via SetLanguageEvent (snowball_stemmer.set_language_code); shipped subscribers map pt-br=>pt and nb/nn=>no. Medium/hard cases are grounded in real Search API db-backed indexes (ss_* ) with the processor enabled; verify reads the live search_api.index.* processor_settings config.

evals.prompt: I have a Search API index on my Drupal 11 site and I want search to match different word forms (e.g. running/runs/ran). The snowball_stemmer module is installed. How do I turn on stemming for that index, and what is the processor called?
evals.expected_output: On the index's Processors tab enable the 'Snowball stemmer' processor (plugin id snowball_stemmer); for best results place it after the Tokenizer, save, and re-index existing content. It stems field values at index time and query terms at search time, per language.

evals.prompt: How do I stem a word from custom PHP on a Drupal site using the snowball_stemmer module's service? Name the service and the calls.
evals.expected_output: Get the snowball_stemmer.stemmer service, call setLanguage($langcode) (returns FALSE if unsupported) then stem($word). E.g. $s = \Drupal::service('snowball_stemmer.stemmer'); if ($s->setLanguage('en')) { $s->stem('running'); } // 'run'. Calling stem() before setLanguage() throws LanguageNotSetException.

evals.prompt: Drupal language codes do not always match the snowball stemmer's language names. How does the snowball_stemmer module let you remap a language code, and what remapping does it ship out of the box?
evals.expected_output: It dispatches a SetLanguageEvent (event name snowball_stemmer.set_language_code) before choosing a stemmer; a subscriber can call setLanguageCode() to change it. Shipped subscribers strip region/locale suffixes (pt-br -> pt) and map Norwegian nb/nn -> no.

evals.prompt: This Drupal site has a Search API index named ss_known that provides word stemming. Inspect the live index configuration and name the processor plugin that performs the stemming.
evals.expected_output: The snowball_stemmer processor is enabled on index ss_known (search_api.index.ss_known -> processor_settings.snowball_stemmer).

evals.prompt: On this site, the snowball_stemmer processor on the Search API index ss_known has a stemming exception configured. Inspect the live index configuration and report the exception word (the key that is force-mapped to a fixed stem).
evals.expected_output: The exceptions map on index ss_known's snowball_stemmer processor contains drupaling => drupal (processor_settings.snowball_stemmer.exceptions).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Search API index named ss_task that does not yet stem search terms. Enable the snowball_stemmer module's Snowball stemmer processor on the ss_task index and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Enable the snowball_stemmer processor on index ss_task (Processors tab, or $index->addProcessor(processorManager->createInstance('snowball_stemmer', ['exceptions' => []])); $index->save();). Verify checks search_api.index.ss_task processor_settings contains snowball_stemmer.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site the Search API index ss_exc already has the snowball_stemmer processor enabled. Configure a stemming exception so the word "acme" is never stemmed (it must map to "acme"), and apply the change to the live index.
evals.expected_output: Add exceptions: {acme: acme} to the snowball_stemmer processor config on index ss_exc (processor_settings.snowball_stemmer.exceptions). Verify checks that exceptions['acme'] === 'acme'.
